attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Montana state income tax calculation. Implements progressive 5-bracket tax structure per MT tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Montana Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi get result.military_retirement_pay get result.mt_military_retirement_taxable get sub sub 0 max /mt_agi xdef
mt_agi result.mt_standard_deduction_single get sub 0 max /mt_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /mt_tax xdef
mt_taxable_income result.mt_bracket_1_limit get min 0 max result.mt_bracket_1_rate get mul /mt_tax xdef
mt_taxable_income result.mt_bracket_1_limit get gt if mt_taxable_income result.mt_bracket_2_limit get min result.mt_bracket_1_limit get sub 0 max result.mt_bracket_2_rate get mul mt_tax add /mt_tax xdef then
mt_taxable_income result.mt_bracket_2_limit get gt if mt_taxable_income result.mt_bracket_3_limit get min result.mt_bracket_2_limit get sub 0 max result.mt_bracket_3_rate get mul mt_tax add /mt_tax xdef then
mt_taxable_income result.mt_bracket_3_limit get gt if mt_taxable_income result.mt_bracket_4_limit get min result.mt_bracket_3_limit get sub 0 max result.mt_bracket_4_rate get mul mt_tax add /mt_tax xdef then
mt_taxable_income result.mt_bracket_4_limit get gt if mt_taxable_income result.mt_bracket_4_limit get sub 0 max result.mt_bracket_5_rate get mul mt_tax add /mt_tax xdef then
mt_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Montana tax calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability get cvs strconcat " (Taxable income: $" strconcat mt_taxable_income cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Montana military retirement deduction calculation. MT National Guard: $15,000 exemption. New residents (after June 30, 2023): 50% deduction for first 5 years from separation. Program expires 2033. Honors MSRRA and SCRA per federal law. Source: MOAA State Report Card.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize MT military retirement deduction calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "MT Military Retirement Deduction Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.mt_military_retirement_taxable xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Is new resident within 5 years of separation
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.is_mt_new_resident get result.years_since_separation get result.mt_new_resident_year_limit get le and

action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay get result.mt_national_guard_exemption get min /mt_exemption_amount xdef
result.military_retirement_pay get mt_exemption_amount sub 0 max /result.mt_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"MT National Guard military retirement exemption applied: $" mt_exemption_amount cvs strconcat " (Retirement pay: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay get cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.mt_military_retirement_taxable get cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Apply MT new resident 50% deduction (5-year limit)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay get result.mt_new_resident_deduction_rate get mul /mt_deduction_amount xdef
result.military_retirement_pay get mt_deduction_amount sub 0 max /result.mt_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"MT new resident military retirement deduction applied: $" mt_deduction_amount cvs strconcat " (Retirement pay: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay get cvs strconcat ", Years since separation: " strconcat result.years_since_separation get cvs strconcat ", Taxable (50%): $" strconcat result.mt_military_retirement_taxable get cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No MT military retirement deduction - fully taxable
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay get /result.mt_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"No MT military retirement deduction applicable - fully taxable: $" result.mt_military_retirement_taxable get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
